pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, clear dark outlines, completely solid uniform fills. No gradients, shading or texture. Complete adult person touching temple with a smile of recollection and turning back toward a blue backpack on a whole chair. Small thought bubble contains same blue backpack, red curved return arrow points back toward bag. REMEMBER, flat solid fills dark outlines, whole person chair bubble and arrow, no words or punctuation. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background. Show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. Zoom OUT, leave one sixth of canvas width empty at both sides, generous white above and below. Natural anatomically correct hands. Plain shoes and clothing. No border. Absolutely no text, writing, letters, numbers, labels, brand marks, emblems, logos or watermarks anywhere.
